angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 2,047,445 km at 95.43 pc = 0.29 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.4790 +/- 0.0324 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01): 95.43 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.943 +/- 0.064 solar radii from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract): 2,047,445 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.212 +/- 0.074 solar masses from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5080 +/- 90 K from Huber et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Huber et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 221416 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-221416.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.584, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 221416 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 IV/V, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 4 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1988MSS...C04....0H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 221416 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.08 dex, from Huber et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 221416 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.71181, from Huber et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 221416 (pscomppars): age 4.9 Gyr, from Huber et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 221416 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.8 km/s, from Huber et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..245H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
